item.description: Gold prices rose in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: USD/INR corrects as RBI intervenes to support Indian Rupee
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains sharply against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair plunges over 1% to near 90.00 from its all-time high of 91.56 due to the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) intervention in the spot and Non-deliverable Forward (NDF) markets.

item.title: The top two emerging markets ETFs
item.description: Emerging markets have been the best performing equity asset class this year, returning about 33% year-to-date. And the conditions that have propelled emerging markets in 2025 are still largely in place to keep the rally going in 2026, according to some analysts.

item.title: Australian Dollar weakens as US Dollar advances on mixed Fed outlook
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) declines against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, extending its losses for the fifth consecutive day.

item.title: USD/CHF gains ground above 0.7950 amid US Dollar strength
item.description: The USD/CHF pair trades in positive territory around 0.7960 during the early European session on Wednesday, bolstered by a rebound in the US Dollar (USD). However, the prospect of the US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate cut next year could weigh on the Greenback against the Swiss Franc (CHF).

item.title: Gold rises to near seven-week highs amid US labor market slowdown
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) extends its upside to near seven-week highs above $4,350 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. The precious metal gains momentum as the US labor market remains relatively resilient but shows signs of slowing.
